description: OBJ-GAP-1 / ADV-ODDS-1: obj_nml_1 is a terrain objective (area-large-2, x 3-10"). A Witchseekers squad (M6) has its front model 6.9" from the area's edge (centroid 13" from the marker). The AI must measure the real gap (edge -> area, not centroid -> marker less 3.79"), see that ANY Advance roll gets a model onto the area this turn, plan ADVANCE obj_nml_1 with 'Turns to get there 1', show the odds on the Suggest card, then actually Advance onto the area when it plays. OBJ-PATH-1: the move heads straight for the area's nearest edge (horizontal here), not diagonally at the marker dot.

steps.comment: front model's base edge is 6.9" from the area
the squad Advanced and a model's base now touches the obj_nml_1 area

OBJ-PATH-1: the lead model (front, 6.9" from the area's right edge, level with it) travels within 8 deg of straight left onto the nearest edge. The marker-centre heading would be ~16 deg (toward y=750). The trailing models re-pack slightly for spacing, so the check is on the lead model's line.
